purpose: Bind the exact physical ReflectionProbe capture/influence configuration to the same request-to-still SHA-256 evidence chain as sun, sky, material and renderer state. A fresh cubemap is not valid evidence if probe placement, volume, capture center, intensity, clipping, culling, clear policy or importance can drift while remaining superficially valid. This contract awards no Visual Fidelity points.
backgroundColorPolicy: No fixed RGB is imposed while clearFlags=Skybox and the physical skybox contract is valid because Unity's fallback clear color is not sampled in the valid path. The finite runtime value is nevertheless fingerprinted so an unexplained request-to-still mutation is rejected.

temporalBinding.reason: The existing async reflection waiter already checks one reflection-lighting SHA-256 at request, every observed Editor poll, completion and immediately before still capture. Folding this probe-state digest into that fingerprint reuses the fail-closed temporal chain without creating a second weaker clock.

prohibitedEvidenceStates: probe moved or rescaled after cubemap request
capture center or influence volume changed after cubemap request
probe intensity or importance changed between cubemap and still
selective culling mask excludes benchmark geometry
solid-color clear replaces the physical skybox
near/far/shadow distance clips physically relevant surroundings
cubemap configuration differs from the canonical authored midsummer benchmark

verification.note: Source-side evidence integrity only. Actual 3840x2160 Unity pixels remain mandatory before Visual Fidelity scoring.
